releases.title: Visible AI work, explainable numbers and a cleaner Case Manager
releases.summary: Everything since 0.1.1 in one release, under a new repository identity and the Apache-2.0 license.

updates.title: What's new, explainable numbers and a cleaner Case Manager

highlights.title: Case tabs in a new order
highlights.summary: Six tabs: Brief, Evidence, AI investigation, Response, Activity and Chat. Alt+2, Alt+4 and Alt+5 open new tabs, and Chat moves to Alt+6.
details: Alt+1 to Alt+6 open the tabs in that order.
Alt+2 now opens Evidence, Alt+4 opens Response and Alt+5 opens Activity.
Chat moves from Alt+5 to Alt+6.

highlights.title: See when the AI is working on a case
highlights.summary: The queue, the case header and the close dialogs show when an AI investigation is running or waiting.
details: The result of the run stays authoritative. A close made while it runs is replaced by its result, and the close dialogs say so first.
When a run you started finishes, your Inbox tells you.

highlights.title: Every risk score shows its math
highlights.summary: Hover a risk score for its formula with the real numbers, or press it for the inputs, the weights and the rounding.

highlights.title: What's new and Communication
highlights.summary: This welcome appears once after each update. The Communication group holds Inbox and What's new, the release tracker.
details: Open Communication, then What's new, to read every release.
Turn the welcome off in Settings, Appearance, with Show What's new after updates.

highlights.title: A quieter sign-in page
highlights.summary: The sign-in page uses the Console's colours and animates once. The Remember me row shows only its name.

highlights.title: Access and account security fixes
highlights.summary: Case reads, the settings read and Standup now check permissions, and account security is stricter.
details: A role without the permission now gets an Access denied answer from these reads.
An account flagged to change its password must change it before anything else.
Multi-factor sign-in locks after 10 failed codes.
A password change signs out your other sessions.
Only a Super admin with a fresh sign-in can change single sign-on settings.

highlights.title: Fixes across the application
highlights.summary: Fixes from a full review of the application, among them reinvestigation, SLA timers, Demo Mode and accessibility.

highlights.title: Apache-2.0 license
highlights.summary: Agentic SOC is free software under the Apache License 2.0.

highlights.title: A new repository identity for updates
highlights.summary: Signed updates now come from ARYDESTROYER/Kavach-AgenticSOC. Set it in .env before you bootstrap the updater.
details: Add `AGENTIC_SOC_UPDATE_REPOSITORY=ARYDESTROYER/Kavach-AgenticSOC` to .env, with that exact case.

updates.title: Team activity, case screenshots and a calmer Case Manager

highlights.title: Team activity
highlights.summary: Per-person, per-day work counts from the audit log, for SOC managers and auditors.
details: Counts come with their context. The page never ranks people or gives them a score.

highlights.title: Screenshots on cases
highlights.summary: Add PNG, JPEG or WebP screenshots to a case. Their metadata is removed and they are never sent to a model.
details: Up to 20 images per case, 2 MiB each and 20 MiB per case.

highlights.title: A review of automatic closes
highlights.summary: About 5% of automatic closes are picked for a person to review, at most 10 a day and 3 per rule.
details: You classify the case before you see what the AI decided.
Reviews stay out of agent statistics. Agent effectiveness shows the agreement once 30 reviews exist.

highlights.title: A switch for role-based access
highlights.summary: A Super admin turns role-based access on or off on Roles and permissions, after a fresh sign-in.

highlights.title: Truthful setup wording
highlights.summary: The setup wizard says Ready for live triage only when a source is connected and the investigation models can be called.

highlights.title: A clearer close
highlights.summary: Closing a case asks for the disposition once and records the actions taken. Rate the AI starts collapsed.

highlights.title: A calmer Case Manager
highlights.summary: One control band, two-line queue rows, one primary action beside Take action, and an eight-section facts rail.

updates.title: A Dashboards library, a usable audit log, rule sheets and Runbooks

highlights.title: Dashboards library
highlights.summary: The Overview row opens a library of four built-in dashboards and your own. The Cyber Defence Center stays the landing page.

highlights.title: An audit log you can use
highlights.summary: Search the audit log, choose a scope, open any record in a side sheet, and export CSV or JSON Lines.
details: Export needs the `audit:export` permission and a fresh sign-in.

highlights.title: A sheet for every rule
highlights.summary: Press any rule name to see that rule's cases and events in one sheet, with Open all in Logs.

highlights.title: One Runbooks feature
highlights.summary: Phased procedures with matching that gives its reason, a run on each case with a Next step card, and reviewed versions.
details: The investigator reads only Published runbook text.

highlights.title: Named severity levels
highlights.summary: Severity breakdowns use named levels, with the top rules and Split by.

highlights.title: Docked navigation and grouped Settings
highlights.summary: The navigation rail docks beside every page, and Settings is grouped.

highlights.title: More room for chat
highlights.summary: The default chat timeouts and capacity are three times larger.

updates.title: Suggested questions and a neater chat

highlights.title: Suggested questions from your data
highlights.summary: A new chat offers 3 or 4 questions built from your own cases and sources, with no model call.
details: Hide a suggestion for a day, or turn suggestions off in the composer options.

highlights.title: Follow-up questions
highlights.summary: After an answer, up to three follow-up questions appear, chosen without a model call.

highlights.title: Conversation titles
highlights.summary: A conversation takes its title from the first answer.

highlights.title: A neater reading column
highlights.summary: Answers sit in a narrower reading column, with quieter block headers and the cost on the meta row.

updates.title: Chat without limits, Remember me and report downloads

highlights.title: Chat without per-question caps
highlights.summary: A question runs until it is answered, with loop guards instead of caps. Chat sits outside the daily and monthly AI budget.
details: An optional chat-only daily cap is off by default.
Every chat call is still recorded in the cost ledger.

highlights.title: A working indicator you can come back to
highlights.summary: The navigation shows when chat is working. Leave the page and come back to the live answer.

highlights.title: Remember me
highlights.summary: Stay signed in on this device for a time your administrator bounds.

highlights.title: Report downloads
highlights.summary: Reports download reliably, now also as Word and Excel files.

highlights.title: Exact counts in chat and dashboards
highlights.summary: Chat and dashboards count cases exactly over any window, all time and calendar periods included.

highlights.title: Overview and Case Manager redesigns
highlights.summary: The Overview and the Case Manager were redesigned, and a closed case shows the analyst's classification first.

highlights.title: Workspace chat
highlights.summary: A read-only assistant that looks things up for you and answers with blocks, citations and reports.
details: A live token meter shows what each answer costs.

updates.title: Cyber Defence Center and required MFA

highlights.title: Cyber Defence Center
highlights.summary: The landing dashboard has a new name, and every metric shows a trendline on hover or focus.

highlights.title: Multi-factor sign-in an administrator can require
highlights.summary: An administrator can require multi-factor sign-in for an account. The person enrolls while signing in.

highlights.title: Richer account creation
highlights.summary: Set a display name, email, phone and custom roles when you create an account, with a live summary of the role.

highlights.title: 38 enrichment providers
highlights.summary: 19 new enrichment providers, each with setup steps and an example on its card.

highlights.title: Authenticator QR codes that scan
highlights.summary: The QR code for authenticator setup now follows the standard, so every scanner reads it.

highlights.title: Signed, supervised updates
highlights.summary: On the PostgreSQL Compose deployment, a Super admin installs a newer Stable release after a signed preflight that can roll back.

highlights.title: Bootstrap from 0.1.1
highlights.summary: Bootstrapping the updater from 0.1.1 no longer stops on application images that carry no state-schema label.
